name: cipher-platform
description: CipherChat + CipherZip 端到端加密平台（模块化 monorepo）

scripts.build:core: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cipherzip/core
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @cipherzip/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @cipherzip/desktop
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cipherzip/core && npm run build -w @cipherzip/cli && npm run build -w @cipherzip/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @cipherzip/core && npm run test -w @cipherzip/cli
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @cipherzip/core
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:core && npm run pack:win -w @cipherzip/desktop

author: Cipher Platform
